_evidence.population: Fresh Clio contains 4,306 activities. Exactly 4,233 are billable, recorded by 8 distinct timekeepers; the population fields exclude all 73 non-billable entries.
_evidence.rule: An affected billable entry is on a person-day with no sent Gmail and no sent Slack message anywhere, and on a matter where another person recorded a Clio activity or note that same day. Grouping affected entries by person and day yields exactly three records. Eleanor's same-day Lumen entry 1320 and Noah's Pelican entries 2892 and 2922 are deliberately excluded because those matters have no other-person corroboration that day.
_evidence.days: 2026-04-04 Eleanor Hartwell: ids 1318 and 1319 on 00001-MeridianBioLabs, 126 minutes, 141,750 cents. 2026-05-20 Noah Feldstein: ids 2884, 2885, 2887, 2896, 2898, 2899, 2910, 2915, and 2923 on 00009-LumenSoftware and 00006-NorthgateMedicalGroup, 414 minutes, 251,850 cents. 2026-06-15 Diane Okonkwo: ids 3753, 3760, 3761, 3762, 3768, 3771, and 3783 on 00003-VeridianEnergyCooperative, 00006-NorthgateMedicalGroup, and 00007-PelicanBayMarina, 336 minutes, 294,000 cents.
_evidence.money: Each affected entry is billable. Its cents contribution is round(Clio public total * 100), after Clio rounds that individual entry total to two decimals. The 18 contributions sum to 687,600 cents; aggregating seconds or hours before rounding is not the certified method.
_evidence.notes: Applying the identical silent-author and other-person same-matter/day corroboration join to all Clio notes yields exactly public note id 176: Diane Okonkwo, 2026-06-15, 00003-VeridianEnergyCooperative.
_evidence.grading: The anomalous-day and phantom-note set weights each split 90% normalized F1 / 10% exact certification. Scalar reconciliation and format carry the remaining weight. Missing, malformed, non-finite, and oversized deliverables score zero.
